meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把界面上看不懂的功能提示讲清楚
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果软件界面里冒出提示,你想弄清它到底在说什么。
copy.tagline_en: Explain any in-app feature tip so you know what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a tip pops up in the interface and you want to know what it means.

howto.what: 当你问起某条 senpi 提示时,它先跑 senpi --list-tips 取真实列表、读你的 settings.json 判断你实际能看到哪些,再读代码,用你的语言给出该提示背后机制的解释并附上文件路径。
howto.when: 当你问某条提示是什么意思、某个被提示的功能怎么工作,或问自己能看到哪些提示时,它接管。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 是什么意思?
say.note: 它会查列表并读代码后再解释

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些提示?
say.note: 它会结合你的 settings.json 说哪些可见

say.text: 这条提示背后的功能是怎么实现的?
say.note: 会点名它读过的文件路径

howto.what_en: When you ask about a senpi tip, it runs senpi --list-tips for the real list, reads your settings.json to see which tips you can actually see, reads the code, and explains that tip's mechanism in your language with file paths.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask what a tip means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line mean?
say_en.note: It checks the live list, then reads the code

say_en.text: Which tips can I actually see?
say_en.note: It reads your settings.json and history

say_en.text: How does this tipped feature work?
say_en.note: It cites the file paths it read
